title: Follow the Geometry, Not the Model: Cold Start Semi-Supervised Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.14451v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern semi-supervised learning (SSL) couples pseudo-label generation and classifier training, using the classifier's own confidence to select the pseudo-labels that are then used to update the model. In the cold-start regime, where at most a few labels per class are available, this coupling is ill-posed, since the classifier cannot supervise itself before it has learned.   To address this problem, we propose VAST (Veracity-Aware Semi-Supervised Training), which decouples these two stages. Probabilistic beliefs over the unlabeled set are first inferred directly from the geometry of a frozen self-supervised embedding and only then distilled into an inductive classifier.   The construction rests on the Veracity Matrix, a kernel-based structure that aggregates label evidence across the data manifold and admits an interpretation as a Dirichlet posterior under a per-observation powered-likelihood model. Additionally, we introduce Veracity P

translated_title: 遵循几何结构，而非模型：冷启动半监督学习
translated_abstract: 现代半监督学习（SSL）将伪标签生成与分类器训练耦合在一起，利用分类器自身的置信度来选择伪标签，进而用于更新模型。在冷启动场景下，即每个类别最多只有少量标签可用时，这种耦合方式是不适定的，因为分类器在完成学习之前无法实现自我监督。为解决这一问题，我们提出了VAST（真实性感知半监督训练），该方法将这两个阶段解耦。首先从冻结的自监督嵌入的几何结构中直接推断未标记数据集上的概率信念，然后再将其蒸馏到一个归纳分类器中。该方法的构建依赖于真实性矩阵（Veracity Matrix），这是一种基于核的结构，能够在数据流形上聚合标签证据，并可解释为在每个观测的加权似然模型下的狄利克雷后验。此外，我们引入了真实性P（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出VAST方法，将伪标签生成与分类器训练解耦，直接从冻结自监督嵌入的几何结构中推断未标记数据的概率信念，从而解决了冷启动半监督学习中分类器无法自我监督的不适定问题。
en_tdlr: VAST decouples pseudo-label generation from classifier training in cold-start semi-supervised learning by inferring probabilistic beliefs directly from the geometry of frozen self-supervised embeddings, resolving the ill-posed problem of a classifier that cannot supervise itself before learning.
